title: Playtest corpus is never published, so QA tickets cannot be regenerated
body:
The playtest session corpus is never published, so QA tickets cannot be regenerated or re-verified anywhere else. origin has no playtest-sessions ref; #367's 51-session corpus lived only in its container and is gone, while a 308-session local store on the operator machine is unpublished and disagrees with the tracked tickets (re-triaging there deleted 47 of 102). qa:triage --verified and staleness therefore depend on which machine runs them.

Make publishing part of the playtest loop (npm run qa:publish exists — wire it in or document when it must run), and have triage read the published corpus back.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
